channel.title: The Medical Journal of Australia - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Medical Journal of Australia (mja.com.au)

item.title: The forgotten pandemic: Hong Kong influenza in Australia (1968–1970)
item.description: Without advance knowledge of the virulence and behaviour of a novel pathogen, pandemic response planning is difficult. Australia’s ability to manage future pandemics will depend not only on robust scientific and health care systems but also on fostering public trust and resilience

item.title: Sex‐ and gender‐responsive management of anxiety disorders: future pathways for research, education, policy and practice
item.description: Better integration of sex and gender considerations in health and medical research, in Australian clinical practice guidelines, and in health and medical education curricula, is needed to improve the quality of care for all people with anxiety disorders

item.title: Federal health workforce policy in Australia and its implications: a descriptive policy document review
item.description: The absence of a unified federal health workforce strategy exacerbates policy fragmentation, undermining coordinated workforce planning and equity

item.title: Opioids and the challenges of managing chronic non‐cancer pain in rural Australia: a qualitative study
item.description: We found a marked disparity between evidence-based guidelines for chronic pain management and the reality of rural medical practice

item.title: Socio‐economic position and the prevalence of ten chronic diseases in Australia, 2021: a whole of population census data analysis
item.description: Knowing whose health is most affected by socio-economic disadvantage is integral for effective, targeted health interventions

item.title: Clinical practice guidelines for hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance for people at high risk in Australia: summary of recommendations
item.description: A summary of recommendations and practice points for key population subgroups who were identified as potentially benefitting from routine hepatocarcinoma surveillance in the form of ultrasound scans, with or without ?-fetoprotein testing

item.title: Greenhouse gas emissions associated with anaesthetic gases in Australia, 2002–2022: a retrospective descriptive analysis
item.description: Continuing to reduce the use of anaesthetic gases will advance the decarbonisation of Australian health care

item.title: The first Australian evidence‐based guidelines on male infertility
item.description: These first Australian evidence-based guidelines will serve as a clinical aid to practitioners who provide services to men with infertility and will facilitate evidence-based care for the most common areas of male infertility

item.title: Changes in patient management after preoperative MRI for newly diagnosed breast cancer: a multicentre prospective observational study
item.description: MRI for selected women where conventional imaging is suboptimal may improve surgical planning and thus afford better outcomes

item.title: A retrospective cross‐sectional analysis of the economic impact of environmental risk factors on inpatient hospital separations in the Northern Territory
item.description: Improving housing, water quality and sanitation will prevent disease and reduce health care expenditure. Delivering on environmental health commitments through meaningful partnerships and coordinated action across sectors is essential for closing the gap
